d: After 13 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and the launch has turned into a global phenomenon. From companies giving employees time off to gamers negotiating playing hours with their spouses, the excitement has spread far beyond the gaming world. In India, gaming cafes are filling up, while streamers are drawing millions of views. Even Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the White House have joined the GTA-inspired buzz.
